result_blind_origin.design_authority: The V21 preregistration explicitly deferred learned-column persistence because X7 and X11 have shared wide-bound and saved-queue meanings. V22 resolves that predeclared structural limitation with Q25-backed offset state and explicit queue restoration; no V21 timing result is an input.

declared_design.summary: Retain V21's five-column 64-candidate masks and first false-survivor mismatch discovery. Store the learned literal byte in Q24 and its offset in Q25. After refining the discovery group, keep that learned column active across every later 64-candidate group, screen it first, and enter the existing ordered exact-verification queue only for survivors of the learned byte plus every authenticated static column.
declared_design.scope: All admitted exact byte literals of widths 6 through 32 on AArch64 ASIMD. No pattern, topology, width, corpus, density, or runtime-result dispatch is permitted in this identity.

unchanged_prefix: V20 primary-first and secondary-only 64-candidate state machine while X11 is zero
V20 verification, quaternary, and quinary refinements
V21 non-destructive first-survivor selection and exact confirmation
learning_transition: A sampled exact miss discovers the first source-order mismatching byte under the same fail-closed length guard as V21.
Broadcast the learned literal byte into Q24 and the learned offset into every byte lane of Q25.
Set X11 to one only after both Q24 and Q25 are initialized.
Apply the learned column to all four retained discovery-group masks.
A nonempty refined discovery group enters the ordered four-mask exact queue; an empty refined discovery group restores the wide cursor and enters persistent learned-wide advance.
persistent_learned_wide_entry: Entry requires X11 equal to one, Q24 equal to the learned literal byte, Q25 equal to the learned offset in every byte lane, X5 at a 64-candidate group base, X15 at that group's primary column, and X7 equal to end_index minus 63.
Extract the Q25 byte offset into a scalar scratch register; Q25 remains unchanged.
Form the learned-column address through X13 and X10 from haystack plus X5 plus the extracted offset; persistent learned/static screening never uses X15 as address scratch.
Load four 16-byte learned-column blocks with two paired loads into Q0/Q2/Q4/Q6 and compare all four against Q24.
If all four learned masks are empty, advance by 64 without loading a static column.
Intersect a nonempty learned mask with the primary column and test presence.
If present, intersect with the secondary column when one exists and test presence.
Apply verification, quaternary, and quinary columns in their existing authenticated order, retaining V20's first-remaining and final presence checkpoints.
Only masks surviving the learned byte and every available authenticated static column enter the ordered exact queue.
persistent_empty_advance: Keep X11 equal to one and Q24/Q25 live.
Continue at persistent learned-wide entry while X5 is at most X7.
Otherwise enter the inherited narrow/tail graph with learned state still active.
ordered_queue: Convert Q0/Q2/Q4/Q6 non-destructively into the existing four scalar sparse masks.
Temporarily set X11 to four only while consuming the fixed four-entry queue.
Exact-verify candidates in block and lane order; false candidates clear only their current sparse bit.
Q24 and Q25 are immutable across sparse conversion and specialized exact verification.
When the queue is exhausted, restore X11 to one, advance to the next 64-candidate group, reconstruct X15 and X7, and resume persistent learned-wide entry.
An exact hit publishes the earliest exact match normally.
narrow_and_tail: The existing V17 learned-column narrow and tail graph consumes X11 equal to one plus Q24/Q25 without changing their meanings.
A no-learning wide exit retains X11 equal to zero and enters the unchanged V21/V17 narrow behavior.
V22 adds no learned-column persistence across invocations.
unchanged_suffix: V17 scalar tail and exact-return ABI
V17, V19, V20, and V21 emitted images
All non-V22 backend policies and wire formats

persistent_state: X11 = 0 before learning and 1 after learning except while the four-entry queue temporarily uses values 4 through 1
Q24 = learned literal byte broadcast to all lanes
Q25 = learned mismatch offset broadcast to all lanes
wide_state: X15 = haystack plus X5 plus primary offset
X15 remains the primary-column pointer throughout persistent learned/static screening and is reconstructed after every exact-verification queue
X7 = end_index minus 63 outside the queue
X14 = sparse-mask constant before a successful return
queue_state: X11 = remaining queue entries including X0
scratch: X0, X1, X2, X3, X10, X13, Q0, Q2, Q4, Q6, Q16, Q18, Q19, Q20, Q21, and condition flags may be clobbered according to the active phase
X15 may be clobbered by exact confirmation and queue verification only; every such exit reconstructs it before persistent learned-wide re-entry
register_contract.persistence: Q24/Q25 and X11 state persist across 64-candidate groups within one invocation only.

requirements: V22 adds no instruction to emitted V17, V19, V20, or V21 images.
The discovery transition contains exactly one pre-refinement full equality and one bytewise mismatch-discovery loop.
Persistent learned-wide empty groups use exactly two paired vector loads for the learned column.
No second learned column, density counter, runtime threshold, or pattern dispatch is emitted.
Q24 and Q25 are never spilled to memory.
All direct branches and relocations remain within authenticated AArch64 encodings.

required: Emitter/template byte-for-byte agreement and whole-image audit acceptance.
Version 35, magic 0x23, AOT, audit, runtime allowlist, mutation, and reseal rejection coverage.
All supported search output contracts emit, audit, serialize, adopt, and execute or explicitly reject V22 consistently.
Mechanical byte identity for frozen V17, V19, V20, and V21 paths against the implementation base commit.
Decoded liveness proof that Q24/Q25 survive sparse conversion, every specialized equality shape for widths 6 through 32, and queue restoration.
Decoded control-flow proof that every persistent entry has X11 equal to one and initialized Q24/Q25.
Exhaustive learned-wide mask algebra over each block/lane and representative four-mask relations.
Learned-empty transitions across at least three consecutive 64-candidate groups followed by an exact match.
Learned-nonempty transitions with false survivors in the same block, later blocks, and later groups preserve source order.
Primary-present/pair-empty and secondary-only transitions before learning remain exact.
Persistent learned-wide transitions bypass the pre-learning secondary-only graph without losing a possible match.
Widths 6 through 32 cover every mismatch offset outside the authenticated static offsets.
Windows cover the wide-to-narrow and narrow-to-tail boundaries at every residue modulo 16.
Randomized windows and left/right guard-page native execution on the EC2 c9g host.

fresh_performance_gate.method: Paired portable/V17/V22; 12 repetitions; all 6 execution orders; approximately 4 ms target per measurement; semantic equality checked before and during timing.

topologies.unique: byte i is 33 + ((17*i) mod 64), unique for the admitted width
topologies.clustered-repeat: fill with '~' and replace the first five bytes with 'A3mQz'
topologies.spaced-repeat: fill with 'x' and write M/N/O/P/R at 0, width/4, width/2, 3*width/4, and width-1 in that order
topologies.seeded-mixed: deterministic xorshift64 stream mapped to a fixed 16-byte printable alphabet, independently seeded by width

scenarios: random-absent with seed 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 mixed with topology and width
dense-near-miss-first-unfiltered using the first offset outside the five authenticated offsets
dense-near-miss-last-unfiltered using the last offset outside the five authenticated offsets
sparse-singleton-unfiltered injected every 257 bytes into an avoiding-byte background

strict_acceptance.artifact_pairs: one frozen V17/V22 pair per topology and width

fresh_performance_gate.on_failure: Seal immutable refusal; do not retest or tune this identity.
fresh_performance_gate.on_success: Require independent review and a fresh formal qualification identity before selection or deployment.
